basic_details.short_information: BRIC-Institute of Life Sciences (ILS), Bhubaneswar, an autonomous institute of the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India, is filling one unreserved (UR) Accountant post (Group B, Pay Level 6 of the 7th CPC) by direct recruitment under Advt. No. 40/2026 dated 19.11.2026. Applicants need a graduate degree, a Diploma in Financial Management and minimum 7 years' experience in the grade of Level 5/4 or equivalent. The maximum age is 30 years. Applications are accepted online only on the ILS website (ils.res.in/advertisements), and the last date is 16.12.

how_to_apply: Apply through online mode only, in the prescribed format available on the ILS website at .
Send the application along with the requisite certificates and relevant documents.

Applicants who must pay the fee send it only by RTGS, Net Banking or UPI. Fee: Rs.400/- for General and Rs.200/- for OBC, non-refundable. No fee is charged from SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and Female applicants.

Bank details for the fee: Beneficiary name: Director, Institute of Life Sciences, Bhubaneswar; Account No.: 450502010006285; Bank: Union Bank of India, Chandrasekharpur; IFS Code: UBIN0545058; UPI Link: https://smartpay.easebuzz.in/137473/ilsonline.

Applicants employed in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs etc. should forward their application through proper channel with an NOC and vigilance clearance from the present employer.

Those unable to apply through proper channel may submit an advance copy with a declaration that the NOC, clearly indicating vigilance clearance, will be furnished at the time of interview/final selection.
Applications received through any other means are not accepted and are summarily rejected. The last date for a complete online application is 16.12.2026; later applications are not considered.
important_instructions: Appointment of selected applicants is subject to being found medically fit as per the requirement of the Institute. The Institute verifies antecedents and documents during the tenure of service; false documents or suppressed antecedents lead to termination and possible legal action. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the test. Call letters and other correspondence are posted on the Institute website www.ils.res.in or sent by email only. Applicants should give a correct email address and check email, including spam, regularly. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification, and no correspondence or personal inquiries are entertained. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason and to modify or cancel an appointment if a mistake is found at any stage. Women applicants are encouraged to apply. Disputes are subject to the sole jurisdiction of the courts at Bhubaneswar/Cuttack. If the Hindi and English versions differ, the English version prevails.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice also lists these technical and functional skills: Working knowledge of computer and ability to work in MS Office packages (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint), spreadsheet, Tally and PFMS (Public Financial Management System) etc. Knowledge of Government of India financial rules and regulations with General Financial Rules (GFR). The maximum age limit is 30 years, and age relaxation is as per Government of India Rule. Eligibility is considered as on the last date of application. Applicants should confirm the exact eligibility in the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: Graduate with Diploma in Financial Management and minimum 7 years' experience in the grade of Level 5/4 or equivalent having the knowledge of financial management etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is at Pay Level 6 (as per 7th CPC). Other allowances on Basic Pay are paid as per Government of India rates applicable to BRIC-ILS, Bhubaneswar. NPS contribution, medical facility for employees and dependents, LTC and Children Education Allowance are also admissible, as per Institute/Government of India rules as applicable from time to time. The position carries a probation period of two years.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-ILS Accountant Job Description
content_sections.text: The position will be responsible for managing the accounts of BRIC-ILS. The post-holder will have to take other responsibilities as assigned by the competent authority from time to time.
